title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: How to Check Remaining Monthly Experiences
content:
Users can check how many experiences they have remaining in the CultPass app:

- Open the CultPass app
- Go to 'My Account' or 'My Pass'
- Check the monthly experience counter
- The counter updates after a reservation is completed or consumed

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can check your remaining monthly experiences in the CultPass app under 'My Account' or 'My Pass'. Your available experience count is shown there."

title: What to Do If a QR Code Is Not Showing
content:
If a user cannot find their QR code after making a reservation:

- Open the CultPass app
- Go to 'My Reservations'
- Select the relevant experience
- Check for the QR code or booking confirmation
- If the QR code is still missing, ask the user to refresh the app and check their confirmation email
- Escalate to human support if the reservation is confirmed but no QR code is available

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Please open 'My Reservations' in the CultPass app and select your experience to view the QR code. If it isn't showing, refresh the app and check your confirmation email. If the issue continues, we can escalate it to support."

title: How to Cancel an Individual Experience Reservation
content:
If a user needs to cancel a specific experience reservation:

- Open the CultPass app
- Go to 'My Reservations'
- Select the relevant booking
- Choose 'Cancel Reservation' if the option is available
- Review any cancellation policy shown before confirming

Cancellation availability may depend on the experience provider's rules.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"To cancel an individual experience, open 'My Reservations', select the booking, and choose 'Cancel Reservation' if available. Please review the cancellation policy before confirming."

title: How to Reschedule an Experience
content:
If a user wants to change the date or time of an experience:

- Open the CultPass app
- Go to 'My Reservations'
- Select the relevant experience
- Look for a 'Reschedule' option
- Choose an available date or time and confirm the change
- If rescheduling is unavailable, the user may need to cancel and make a new reservation according to the experience policy

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can check whether your reservation can be rescheduled by opening it under 'My Reservations'. If a reschedule option is available, select a new date or time and confirm the change."

title: What to Do If an Experience Is Fully Booked
content:
If an experience is fully booked:

- Check whether a waitlist option is available
- If available, join the waitlist through the CultPass app
- Monitor the app or notifications for an opening
- Do not promise that a waitlisted user will receive a spot

**Suggested phrasing:**
"If an experience is fully booked, check whether a waitlist is available in the CultPass app. You can join it if offered, but availability is not guaranteed."

title: How to Join an Experience Waitlist
content:
When an experience has a waitlist:

- Open the experience in the CultPass app
- Tap 'Join Waitlist' if the option is displayed
- Confirm the waitlist request
- Keep notifications enabled so the user can be informed if a spot becomes available
- A waitlist request does not guarantee admission

**Suggested phrasing:**
"If the experience offers a waitlist, open it in the CultPass app and tap 'Join Waitlist'. Keep your notifications enabled in case a spot becomes available."

title: What to Do After Missing a Reserved Experience
content:
If a user misses an experience they reserved:

- Check the experience's cancellation and no-show policy
- Explain that unused reservations may still count against the monthly allowance depending on the applicable policy
- Do not promise restoration of an experience credit
- Escalate exceptions to human support when appropriate

**Suggested phrasing:**
"If you missed a reserved experience, please check the booking's cancellation or no-show policy. Whether the experience credit can be restored depends on the applicable policy, and support can review exceptions."

title: How to Find Available Experiences Near You
content:
Users can discover nearby experiences through the CultPass app:

- Open the experience catalog
- Use location or city filters when available
- Browse experiences by category, date, or location
- Select an experience to view its address, schedule, and reservation requirements

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Open the CultPass experience catalog and use the available location or city filters to find experiences near you. You can select an experience to see its location and schedule."

title: How to Check Experience Details Before Booking
content:
Before reserving an experience, users should review the experience details in the CultPass app:

- Check the date and start time
- Review the location and directions
- Check age or eligibility requirements
- Review whether additional fees apply
- Check cancellation or reservation rules
- Confirm any special arrival instructions

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Before reserving, review the experience page for the date, time, location, eligibility requirements, additional fees, and any special instructions."

title: What to Do If a Reservation Fails
content:
If a user receives an error while trying to reserve an experience:

- Confirm that the experience still has available spots
- Ask the user to close and reopen the CultPass app
- Check that the app is updated
- Retry the reservation
- If the reservation still fails, capture the error details and escalate to human support

Do not tell the user that a reservation is confirmed unless the app displays a confirmation.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"If your reservation isn't going through, please check that spots are still available, restart the CultPass app, and try again. If you still receive an error, support can investigate it for you."

title: How to Update Account Information
content:
Users can update eligible account information through the CultPass app:

- Open 'My Account'
- Select the relevant profile or account setting
- Update the available information
- Save the changes

If a particular field cannot be edited in the app, the user should contact human support for assistance.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update available profile information from 'My Account' in the CultPass app. If the information you need to change cannot be edited there, please contact support."

title: How to Update a Payment Method
content:
If users need to change their payment method:

- Open the CultPass app
- Go to 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan' or the available billing section
- Select the payment method option if available
- Enter the new payment details and save
- If payment details cannot be updated in the app, escalate to billing support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can check the billing section under 'My Account' to see whether your payment method can be updated. If the option isn't available, please contact billing support."

title: What to Do If a Subscription Payment Fails
content:
If a subscription payment fails:

- Check whether the payment method is still valid
- Confirm that sufficient funds are available
- Update the payment method if the app provides the option
- Retry the payment
- If the subscription remains unpaid, contact support for account-specific assistance

Do not promise that access will remain active after a failed payment unless the account status confirms it.

**Suggested phrasing:**
"If your subscription payment failed, please check your payment method and available funds, then retry the payment. If the issue continues, support can help review your subscription status."

title: How to Contact Human Support
content:
Users should be escalated to human support when self-service troubleshooting does not resolve the issue or when an account-specific investigation is required.

Common escalation cases include:
- Persistent login problems
- Confirmed reservations without a QR code
- Repeated reservation errors
- Billing disputes
- Account access issues
- Exceptions to cancellation or no-show policies

**Suggested phrasing:**
"If the troubleshooting steps haven't resolved the issue, or if your account needs to be reviewed, I can direct you to human support for further assistance."

title: How to Check Whether an Experience Has an Additional Fee
content:
Some CultPass experiences may have an additional fee:

- Open the experience in the CultPass app
- Review the pricing information before reserving
- Any applicable additional fee should be displayed during the reservation process
- Do not tell users that an experience is free unless the app confirms it

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Some experiences may have an additional fee. Please check the experience page and reservation screen in the CultPass app for the current price before confirming your booking."
